title: Universal Wigner Negativity for Pure Spin States via pi-Rotation Orthogonality
description: We prove that for every spin j in (1/2)N (j >= 1/2), every pure state in C^{2j+1}, and every SU(2)-covariant self-dual Stratonovich-Weyl spherical Wigner function on S^2, the Wigner function strictly attains negative values. This settles the open conjecture of Davis, Kumari, Mann, and Ghose (2021) / Davis, Hennigar, Mann, and Ghose (2023) (Open Quantum Problem F18) and completes the constant-curvature trichotomy for pure-state Wigner positivity. The proof establishes universal pi-rotation orthogonality for all pure spin states via oddness (half-integer spin) and complex spherical harmonic zeros combined with an exact equatorial integral identity (integer spin). This archive includes the LaTeX manuscript (paper.tex, paper.pdf), a complete zero-sorry Lean 4 (v4.36.0 + Mathlib4) formalization verified against standard Lean axioms only, and an independent exact-Racah Python numerical verification script.
